summary: Enza Capital is a multi-stage investor in African technology companies with offices in Nairobi, Cairo, Johannesburg, London and New York. Its homepage lists a sector focus on fintech, AI, logistics, human capital, education, energy and climate, cybersecurity and healthcare, investment stages from pre-seed to Series B, and a geographic focus on ten African countries including Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt and South Africa. Portfolio names include SeamlessHR and Djamo. Check size, an application route and a street address are not stated.
